summary: preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated payload at install time
details: This package presents itself as an ESLint configuration but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style `_0xXXXX` identifiers and per-function string-lookup tables that hide its control flow. On install it detects platform/arch, downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and then runs a sibling file `math_init.js` under that freshly-downloaded runtime via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line blob prefixed `// @bun @bun-cjs` containing a large numeric/string constant array indexed via an array-rotation decoder (`WV8StW`) — the standard obfuscator.io string-array pattern. A static ESLint config has no need for a language runtime or an opaque runtime payload; executing the payload under an alien runtime bypasses Node-based inspection at the moment of install. The package also grafts these artifacts onto an otherwise legitimate-looking `@ornikar/eslint-config-babel-use` index.js in the `@ornikar` scope, consistent with a hijacked-maintainer or lookalike republish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
